legend.black bin icon with asterisk: rest (40-Liter-Behälter mit vierwöchentlicher Leerung; always on the same date as the plain bin icon in this window)
legend.!: Feiertagsverschiebung marker (date printed is already the shifted date)

notes: Only one district is printed on this PDF ('Northeim Bezirk 1'), so there was no picking between districts. All pickups fall on Tuesdays, alternating gelb+bio, rest(+glas every other time), papier+bio in a roughly 2-week rhythm. The small icon pairs (bag+leaf vs flag+leaf, plain bin vs bin+bottle) were cross-checked against the printed bottom legend at 400dpi to avoid mixing up gelb/papier or rest/glas. One pickup (2026-03-30) carries the Feiertagsverschiebung '!' mark, meaning it was moved off its usual day; it is labelled on the printed (shifted) date.
